evidence.quote: PURPOSE:To provide a magnetic recording medium in which the durability is enhanced and the clogging of a head is improved and a method for manufacturing it.

PURPOSE:To obtain a high-quality magnetic recording medium which is balanced overall in performance by forming the recording medium into the combined structure of a thin-film magnetic layer consisting of an iron nitride system, projecting parts, org. protective layer and back layer.

PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a high quality image recording material by which recesses and projections in a sub-micron (1 μm or less) range are formed on at least part of an image surface after image recording
